system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you would cast a Jutsu that would grant you DR (Damage Reduction), you can spend a superiority die. When you do, creatures under the effects of your Projected gain the benefit of the jutsu cast, until the end of the current turn. If you would roll to determine the damage reduction gained, you add your Superiority die to the result.
